==English==
{{wp}}
[[Image:Gerizim Samaritan Torah IMG 2118.JPG|thumb|An open [[Samaritan]] '''Torah'''.]]

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|Toráh|q=obsolete|Torāh|q2=uncommon|Tōrāh|q3=uncommon}}

===Etymology===
{{bor+|en|he|תּוֹרָה||instruction, law or teaching|tr=tōrā}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|tôrə}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈtɔːɹə/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-Torah.wav|a=Southern England}}
** {{IPA|en|[ˈtʊɹɑ]|a=MLE}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɔːɹə|s=2}}

===Proper noun===
{{en-prop|def=1}}

# {{sid|en|Q34990}}{{lb|en|Abrahamism}} The first five [[book]]s of the [[Hebrew Scriptures]], traditionally attributed to [[Moses]] and therefore also known as the Five Books of Moses. {{defdate|1570s<ref name="Etymonline">{{R:Etymonline}}</ref>}}
#: {{syn|en|Five Books of Moses<id:Q34990>|Books of Moses<id:Q34990>|Chumash<id:Q34990>|Law<id:Q34990>|Pentateuch<id:Q34990>}}
#: {{hol|en|Tanakh<id:Q83367>|Hebrew Bible|Jewish Bible|Septuagint}}
#: {{mero|en|Genesis|Exodus|Leviticus|Numbers|Deuteronomy}}
#: {{comeronyms|en|Ketuvim|Nevi'im}}
#: {{ux|en|Tradition holds that the '''Torah''' was handed down to Moses on Mount Sinai.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Christina Maxouris and Doug Criss|title=Everything you wanted to know about Yom Kippur|url=https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/08/us/yom-kippur-meaning-trnd/index.html|date=2019-10-08|passage=Services during Yom Kippur are held continuously through the day and include readings from the '''Torah''' and the reciting of prayers expressing regret or asking for forgiveness.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191214042256/https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/08/us/yom-kippur-meaning-trnd/index.html}}
# {{lb|en|Judaism}} The full body of written [[Jewish]] [[law]], including the [[Tanakh]], the [[Talmud]], the [[Mishnah]] and the [[midrashic]] texts.
#: {{ux|en|It says in the '''Torah''' that both gossip and murder cause irreparable damage.}}
# {{lb|en|Judaism}} The whole of Jewish [[law]], both written and unwritten.
# {{lb|en|Judaism}} The encompassing [[philosophy]] of [[Judaism]].

====Usage notes====
* The definite article is optional.
